name: Failure & Comeback
q: Failure is the mother of success
Since I've fallen, might as well rest
I found ten thousand ways that won't work
What matters is rising, not falling
What doesn't kill me makes me stronger
Before great tasks, heaven tests with hardship
One day, remembering this will please
We learn more wisdom from failure
Meet with Triumph and Disaster, and treat those two impostors just the same
Our glory is rising every time we fall
Any man can err, but only a fool persists in error
Our work is to fail in good spirits
Fall down seven times, get up eight
The noble person seeks it in himself; the small person seeks it in others
